loops.description: Guardrails audit loop: preflight, pick random area, audit against project guardrails, score, /plan-story for 3 issues

tasks.name: Preflight: clean tree + sync main
commandArgs: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && git switch main && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tasks.name: Check no audit already running
commandArgs: count=$(gh issue list --label "audit:doing" --state open --limit 1 --json number --jq 'length'); test "$count" -eq 0 || exit 75

tasks.name: AI: audit random area against guardrails, /plan-story for top issues
commandArgs: First, load all skills available for your current agent. Then audit a random area of the Orbion project (renderer at src/renderer/, main process at src/main/, preload at src/preload/, or shared at src/shared/). Load @ob-guardrails-project, @plain-engineering-conventions, and @ob-guardrails-generic. Find at least 6 problems, score each 1-10. For the top 3, create GitHub issues with labels 'bug' and 'code:pick' using /plan-story. Skip duplicates. Create a summary issue with label 'audit:report' listing all findings. Link each created issue as a sub-issue of the summary report. Do not modify code, push, or ask for confirmation. Never explore outside the repository root.

tasks.name: Verify: at least 1 new issue created with bug label
commandArgs: count=$(gh issue list --label "bug" --state open --limit 100 --json number,createdAt --jq '[.[] | select(.createdAt > (now - 3600 | todate))] | length'); test "$count" -gt 0 && git checkout -- . && git clean -fd && exit 0 || exit 1

tasks.name: Recovery: cleanup audit:doing state
commandArgs: open_issues=$(gh issue list --label audit:doing --state open --json number --jq '.[].number'); for id in $open_issues; do gh issue edit "$id" --remove-label audit:doing 2>/dev/null; done; git checkout -- . && git clean -fd; exit 0

tasks.name: Audit already in progress
commandArgs: Nothing to do - audit already in progress
